observations: Orange gas cylinder with a mesh protective cage.
A regulator is attached to the top of the cylinder.
The cylinder is sitting on a grey upholstered surface.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be expired or past its re-test date.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the manufacture and expiry date stamped on the handle or collar.

risks.risk: The regulator may be faulty or have a leak.
risks.proof: A video showing the regulator being tested with soapy water on the threads.

risks.risk: The cylinder may be empty or contain a different gas than propane.
risks.proof: A photo of the weight stamp on the handle or collar.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the weight stamp on the handle or collar of the cylinder.
Photo of the regulator attached to the cylinder.
Video of the regulator being tested for leaks.
Photo of the expiry date stamped on the cylinder.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
